annotation.speech2: Three panels labelled a, b and c. Each shows a blue vector A pointing up and to the right and a green vector B pointing up and to the left from a common tail. Panel a adds an orange vector from the tip of A to the tip of B, labelled B minus A. Panel b adds a short dark red vector pointing backwards along the line of A, labelled the projection of B onto A, together with dashed construction lines. Panel c adds a small circle with a dot at its centre, labelled A cross B out of the page.
The vector B minus A, drawn from the tip of A to the tip of B.
The projection of B onto A, which points opposite to A because the angle between A and B is obtuse.
A circle with a dot at its centre, the standard symbol for a vector pointing out of the page, representing A cross B.
